text:
Type: tall five-drawer storage chest
Use: storing clothes, toys and supplies in drawers; children's room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white laminated board body, birch wood-look and white drawer fronts, cut-out finger grips
Colors: white, light natural birch
Shape: narrow upright box with two shallow white drawers above three deep birch drawers, rectangular cut-out handles, flat top, sits flush on the floor, simple and slim, medium visual weight
Feel: light, warm, tidy, friendly
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, pastel textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms, bedrooms and small home offices

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
